title: Atomic surface-evaporation accepted publication
triggering_authorities: F-PM09 G01 accepted-publication provenance closure gap
design_disposition: Close cross-candidate result substitution by construction at the runtime publication seam: materialize attribution with the exact candidate, commit that same candidate, and publish only the private local attribution using the receipt produced by that same call. Do not rely on globally unique executor identifiers.
qualification_requirement: Owner evidence is not independent qualification. F-VQ successor must independently verify atomic publication, fail-closed negative cases, MultiSWAP-compatible split trial/commit executors, source binding, and no second mass authority before canonical admission.
